title: USA Rare Earth, Inc. 8-K Filing — Agreement and Plan of Merger
summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) entered into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger on April 19, 2026 to acquire SVRE Holdings Ltd. through a merger transaction valued at $300 million cash plus 126,849,307 shares of USAR common stock. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
key_points: USAR and Merger Sub (indirect wholly-owned subsidiary) are parties to the merger agreement with SVRE Holdings Ltd.
SVRE shareholders will receive $300,000,000 in aggregate cash consideration and 126,849,307 shares of USAR common stock.
DFC Warrants and SVRE Shareholder Warrants will be automatically exercised and converted into SVRE Shares prior to closing.
SVRE RSUs, SARs, and non-Performance-Vesting Options will vest and be cancelled in exchange for merger consideration.
Transaction expected to close no later than Q3 2026 pending satisfaction of closing conditions.
USAR common stock trades on Nasdaq under symbol USAR.
